<!-- e.g. a monthly service report, inspection pack, or invoice PDF. No customer names. -->

### Target environment
<!-- e.g. .NET 10 Linux container, Windows x64, CLI process, expected volume (optional). -->

### Constraints and required outcome
<!-- What makes a solution fit? e.g. repeated header rows, searchable text, bounded runtime, or a particular failure/recovery behavior. Do not assume an unsupported CSS feature works. -->

<!-- Optional link to synthetic/public HTML or a short feature list. No customer files, screenshots with private data, or licensed fonts. -->
